vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: xiaoding-stock
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is a legitimate stock query tool that fetches real-time market data from the Sina Finance API (hq.sinajs.cn). The implementation in bin/stock.js uses standard Node.js libraries, includes input validation via regular expressions to prevent injection, and contains no evidence of data exfiltration, persistence, or malicious instructions.

llm.summary: The skill appears to be a simple CLI that fetches A-share and Hong Kong quotes from Sina, but its description/README claims US market support (and some metadata mismatches), so the declared purpose does not fully match the actual code.

dimensions.detail: The skill's description and SKILL.md claim support for A-share, Hong Kong, and US markets. The included code (bin/stock.js) only implements A-share (6-digit codes) and Hong Kong (5-digit codes) and explicitly rejects non-numeric tickers (so US tickers like AAPL/MSFT are not supported). This is a clear mismatch between stated purpose and actual capability. Additionally, source/homepage are unknown which makes verification harder.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs using a local 'stock' CLI and shows examples that include US tickers (which the code won't handle). The runtime instructions and code only perform an outbound HTTPS GET to hq.sinajs.cn and parse returned CSV-like data. The instructions do not ask the agent to read local files, environment variables, or transmit data to unexpected endpoints. The code sets a Referer header and performs normal network calls to the declared Sina endpoint.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install script that downloads remote artifacts. This is an instruction-only skill with an included Node CLI script and package.json that declares a bin. It uses only Node built-in 'https' and has no third-party downloads or extract-from-URL steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The code does not access environment secrets. Outbound network access to hq.sinajs.cn is required, which is proportional to its stated function of fetching stock data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent or elevated privileges (always:false). It does not modify other skills or system-wide settings. Autonomous invocation remains possible by default, but that is normal and not combined with other high-risk factors here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package appears to be a small, transparent Node CLI that fetches A-share and Hong Kong quotes from Sina and prints formatted output. However: (1) the skill's documentation and description incorrectly claim US market support while the code only supports numeric A/HK tickers—expect US tickers to fail. (2) Source/homepage are unknown, so you can't easily audit updates or author reputation beyond the included files. Before installing: verify you only need A-share/HK support (or get an updated version that actually supports US markets), run the script in a sandbox or restricted environment first, and inspect the code yourself (or request the upstream repository) if you need stronger assurance. Note the script makes outbound HTTPS requests to hq.sinajs.cn (no credentials sent). If you don't trust network calls from this machine, don't install or run it there.
